description: Search the Italian tax practice (prassi): circolari, risoluzioni, provvedimenti of the Agenzia delle Entrate and interpelli answers of the MEF DocTrib. Hybrid mode fuses full-text (italian, oggetto + text) and vector ranking over the passages with reciprocal rank fusion. Each hit gives the extremes (id, tipo, numero, anno, data, ente, oggetto), a highlight (headline, only for a full-text match), a short snippet (best passage, at most 700 characters) and the source_url; read the full text with it-prassi_doc by id. Parameters: query (web-search syntax), k (1..50, default 10), mode (hybrid, lexical, semantic), filters tipo (circolare, risoluzione, provvedimento, interpello; case-insensitive), ente (substring), anno_from and anno_to. With no query the documents are listed by tipo, anno, numero (a call without any parameter lists the first page). Prassi is the administration's interpretation, not a source of law. Example: {"query": "regime impatriati", "tipo": "interpello", "anno_from": 2024}.
